[.walkthrough]
.Pad the buttons' layout and center the view
. Select a layout, here the one around the buttons: click Save and press `←` for its parent. The layout's [.walkthrough-look]#badge# has the *Pad* and *Gap* switches, and *Alignment*.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/spacing-and-alignment/01-select.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/spacing-and-alignment/01-select.jpg"]
. Turn *Pad* on. The [.walkthrough-look]#layout# gets padding around its buttons, and Copilot writes it to [filename]#ContactView.java#.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/spacing-and-alignment/02-padding.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/spacing-and-alignment/02-padding.jpg"]
. Click beside the form to select the view, which is a vertical layout too. In *Alignment*, choose to align its components to the center: the title, the form and the buttons move to the middle.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/spacing-and-alignment/03-align.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/spacing-and-alignment/03-align.jpg"]
